title: E9 shed victim identity ("NEWEST" of the shed lane) is not unit-pinned — only drop class+count are asserted
detail: All 21 combos assert class+count of the drop, never WHICH queued packet was spliced; each lane's parked packets share one class, so shedding the oldest/middle instead of the newest passes every assertion. Behavior is correct today (newest_in_bundle_lane walks from the tail) and the golden pins current bytes, but the E9 'NEWEST' contract is only incidentally pinned.
recommended_fix: In the E9 combos, park per-lane packets with distinct ids and assert the shed victim is the lane's last-joined id (in_flight(victim_id) == false, newest_id == shed id), e.g. track the newest parked id per lane.

title: Tag-conditional event payload (pre-3.3 event bytes unchanged) has no dedicated regression pin — append-only rests on code shape only
detail: The serialize.odin comment claims append-only ('pre-3.3 event streams stay byte-identical'), but no test asserts the old-tag event-section byte layout; the only EVENT_TAG_PACKET_DROPPED test reference is count_drops (qos_test.odin:392). The light-demo goldens cannot catch a regression either — catalog_hash folding (state_writer line 88) re-blessed every per-tick line, so a writer change would only fail the golden gate if NOT re-blessed. P3: mechanism verified correct by inspection.
recommended_fix: Add a byte-level pin: hash/serialize a run whose events contain only pre-3.3 tags and assert the event section length is exactly (len+1)*9 bytes (u64 tick + u8 tag each) — no class/reason words for old tags.
